scope: Four explicitly requested tickets; five entries including the missing WIXOSS parent work
limitations: No official cheering/support HEX standard was established. Requested HEX values are preserved where specified; artwork/logo samples are MeQR representative colors, not official color specifications.

entries.basis: Official Japanese/Taiwan Pokédex verifies Hisuian form, shell and localized name. HEX is the ticket's requested representative purple, not an extracted official body color.
Missing WIXOSS parent work; representative blue sampled as the most frequent fully opaque chromatic pixel (channel spread >100) in the official logo.
Takara Tomy official card SP05-003 verifies ピルルク and color 青. HEX preserves the ticket's requested representative cool blue, not an official HEX specification.

THBWiki/Moegirl verify names and green hair; sample from the original PoFV artwork mirrored by specialist THBWiki, matching the requested green. This is an artwork representative color, not an official support HEX.

Official gynoid singing product verifies duo names and VOCALOID5 voicebanks. Pink/light-blue colors are hair-region medians from the official product cover; classified in VOCALOID, not the non-VOCALOID general subgroup.
